roles.title: People Operations Intern
roles.description: ABOUT THE ROLE As a People Operations Intern, you’ll get hands-on experience at the heart of our People team in Amsterdam. You’ll support key HR processes, help keep our systems running smoothly, and be a go-to contact for employee questions. Along the way, you’ll collaborate on exciting projects, improve how we work, and take ownership of your own tasks. It’s a great opportunity to learn, grow, and make a real impact on the employee experience. ABOUT DATASNIPPER We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Support day-to-day People Operations activities, including administrative processes throughout the employee lifecycle and payroll-related tasks. - Maintain and update HR systems ensuring data accuracy through regular audits and checks. - Contribute to global People Team and Office projects and initiatives, collaborating with stakeholders across regions. - Act as a first point of contact for employee queries, ensuring timely and helpful responses. - Assist in documenting, optimizing, and standardizing People processes. - Take ownership of smaller operational workflows to support smooth day-to-day team operations. - Coordinate employee onboarding schedule - Own the People Team newsletter What you bring - Currently studying Human Resources, Business, or a related field. - Fluent in English; strong command of Dutch is a plus - Strong attention to detail and a structured way of working. - A proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and take ownership. - A collaborative communicator who enjoys working across teams. - Interest in People Operations and creating a positive employee experience. What We Offer - Internship duration: 6 months. - Hybrid working model, 3 days onsite at our Amsterdam HQ. - Hands-on experience in global People Operations. - Learn how HR processes scale in a fast-growing organization. - Being part of one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups in the Netherlands. - International and collaborative work environment. - Delicious daily lunch prepared fresh by our chef in the Amsterdam office. - Fun team events and social activities. 🚀 If this sounds like you, apply now! We can’t wait to welcome our next intern.

roles.title: People Operations Intern
roles.description: About Etched Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. Job Summary We are looking for a sharp, high-agency intern to support People Operations and Legal. You will own real work across compliance, audits, employee operations, contracts, and company projects. You will investigate problems, organize messy information, work across teams, and drive projects through completion. The role is based in our San Jose office. Key Responsibilities - Run People and Legal internal audits, including employment agreements, I-9s, policies, and employee records - Track compliance requirements and prepare filings, reports, and supporting records - Review data across Rippling, spreadsheets, and source documents to find and fix gaps - Support contracts, signatures, document storage, and other Legal operations - Help manage onboarding, offboarding, employee changes, and recruiting handoffs - Build clear guides and processes for employees, including travel and office resources - Coordinate with People, Legal, Finance, Recruiting, and workplace teams - Research employment and business requirements and turn findings into clear next steps - Take on time-sensitive projects as the company grows You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications) - Current undergraduate or recent graduate interested in People Operations, Legal, or business operations - Strong attention to detail - Clear written and verbal communication - Good judgment with sensitive information - Able to work through incomplete or conflicting information - Comfortable using spreadsheets and learning new systems - Organized, reliable, and quick to follow through - Willing to ask questions, find answers, and take ownership Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications) - Previous internship, campus leadership, or volunteer experience involving administrative or operational support - Familiarity with HR, recruiting, or document management systems - Experience reviewing records, reconciling data, or flagging discrepancies - Experience documenting processes or suggesting ways to make routine tasks more efficient We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification. Program details - 12-week paid internship - Generous housing support for those relocating - Daily lunch and dinner in our office - Based at our office in San Jose, CA - Direct mentorship from industry leaders and world-class engineers - Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time For any questions, contact internships@etched.com. internships@etched.com How we’re different Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors. We are a fully in-person team in San Jose and Taipei, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

roles.title: People Team Intern, HR Transformation (Winter 2027)
roles.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available locations: Austin, TX San Francisco, CA Available Term Winter (January - April 2027) About the Role Cloudflare's HR/AI Transformation team makes HR work simpler and more effective. We redesign how work gets done, build internal tools (including AI tools), and run learning programs that help people adopt new ways of working. As our intern working on programs and processes, you'll help run those learning programs, keep our projects on track, and turn people's challenges into clear problem statements and process maps. You'll work directly with the head of AI Transformation & People Strategy, alongside HR leaders, process owners and engineers. This internship starts in January 2027 and is designed for a current student who is highly organized, writes clearly and is curious about how AI can improve the way people work. Responsibilities Plan and run our learning programs, including scheduling sessions, coordinating speakers and materials, and sending announcements and follow-ups. Maintain a single, up-to-date view of all team projects, and follow up with project owners to keep work moving. Write short, clear status updates for team leaders and stakeholders. Meet with people across the HR function to understand their challenges, and summarize what you learn in clear problem statements. Document how key processes work today, and help prepare workshops to redesign them. Own one project from start to finish, with a named sponsor and a clean handoff at the end of your internship. Requirements Currently enrolled in a program studying business or similar. Experience planning and managing projects or programs. Strong written communication, including the ability to turn a messy conversation into a clear, simple summary. Strong organization and follow-through across many people, details and deadlines. Confidence working with senior leaders and reaching out to people you haven't met. Hands-on experience using AI tools in your work or studies. Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship. In office 3-5 days a week. Nice-to-Have Skills Background in consulting, operations, HR or process improvement. Experience with process mapping, user research or workshop facilitation. Familiarity with capacity planning and project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana or Smartsheet. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated hourly rate of $27.00/hr. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

roles.title: Philanthropy Intern - Spring 2027
roles.description: Who We Are International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable. We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve. The Need For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Philanthropy Intern to join the 2027 Spring Internship class. The Philanthropy Intern will join the US Philanthropy team, which serves the organization by connecting generous donors with the inspiring work happening in IJM’s programs and inviting them to engage deeper. The Philanthropy Intern will support the organization's largest revenue-raising arm on critical projects. Tasks may include: Project coordination; Events/logistics planning; Fundraising campaign planning; Database management; and Participating in departmental and general IJM administrative support. This position can be fully in-person or hybrid (onsite Tuesdays & Thursdays) in the Washington, DC area or remote for non-local candidates. It reports to the Administrator, Philanthropy. The position requires 30-40 hours per week, primarily during the hours of 8:30am-5:30pm EST. As volunteers, interns and fellows receive a monthly stipend to help defray their expenses related to participating in the internship program. This volunteer stipend is not an hourly wage, nor wages paid for services provided by the intern or fellow. Spring internship program dates are January 11 – April 9, 2027. Application Deadline : September 25, 2026. General Qualifications and Required Skills Prospective interns need to have completed at least two years of undergraduate study by the start of their internship. At least one prior professional internship experience or significant leadership experience in extracurricular, campus, volunteer, or community-based organizations. Ability to commit to a schedule consistent with the required time commitment listed above (20, 30, or 40 hours per week during standard business hours). Experience and interest in project management and event planning. Experience and interest in fundraising Experience in database management. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Critical Qualities Mature orthodox Christian faith; Humble and resilient; Pursues excellence; Culturally aware and appreciative of difference; Strong service ethic; Innovative problem solver; Ability to build trust and strong partnerships with others; Courageous in pursuing opportunities and challenges; Tenacious in achieving goals; and Professional. Application Process: Upload Resume, Cover Letter & Statement of Faith* in one PDF document . *What is a statement of faith? A statement of faith should describe your Christian faith and how you see it as relevant to your involvement with IJM. The statement can either be incorporated into the cover letter or submitted as a separate document and should include, at a minimum, a description of your spiritual disciplines (prayer, study, etc.) and your current fellowship or place of worship. IJM holds strict safeguarding principles and a zero tolerance to violations of the Safeguarding Policy, Protection against Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment Policy, and Code of Ethics. Candidate selection is based on technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring criteria subject to assessing the candidate’s value congruence and thorough background, police clearance, and reference check processes. At IJM, we’re committed to building a diverse workforce through fair and equitable employment practices. IJM encourages people of any race, color, age, sex, marital status or political ideology to apply for employment. While we welcome everyone into this work, we truly believe that the work we are doing is God’s work, not our own, and practice spiritual disciplines together daily. That’s why we legally require under SEC. 2000e-1 [Section702] of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 that all employees practice a mature orthodox Christian faith, as defined by the Apostles’ Creed. IJM requires a background check, police clearance and thorough review of references with an employment offer and/or employment contract. #LI-BR1 #LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote

roles.title: Product Development, Design & Consumer Insights Co-op Spring Opportunities (Jan-Jun 2027)
roles.description: About Us SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja , the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. AI at SharkNinja At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in. Join the SharkNinja Early Edge Experience: Built for early career talent. Geared toward impact. Driven by speed. Whether you’re in a co-op or internship, our early talent program is designed to provide valuable exposure to the industry and a fast-paced professional environment. You’ll dive into meaningful projects and tasks that sharpen your skills and deepen your knowledge. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development opportunities, community events, and connections that make your experience well-rounded and enriching. Your time with us will culminate in an opportunity to showcase your contributions and learnings to SharkNinja leaders because this is a program for those ready to shape what’s next — fast. Are you the person who takes the product apart to see how it works, then redesigns it in your head? Do you want to know why people buy what they buy — and then go build the thing they didn’t know they needed? Are you excited by the challenge of turning an insight into a product that lands in millions of homes? If so, we invite you to learn more about Product Development, Design & Consumer Insights Co-op opportunities at SharkNinja. This is a single application for product development, design, and consumer insights early talent roles across SharkNinja. The hiring teams are spread across our product development, industrial and experience design, culinary, consumer insights, and consumer experience functions. Whichever team you join, you’ll work on real products and real launches alongside people who have shipped them before. You might be sketching a concept that becomes a hero product, specifying the exact color and finish a consumer sees on the shelf, running usability sessions on a connected app, testing recipes to prove out what an appliance can really do, digging into field feedback to close a consumer pain point, or synthesizing research into the recommendation that changes a product’s direction. If you’re curious, consumer-obsessed, hands-on, and ready to make an impact from day one, we want to hear from you! Teams that you can be connected to through this posting include: Product Development (Shark, Ninja, and Beauty) Ninja Test Kitchen / Culinary Development Industrial Design CMF (Color, Material & Finish) Design UX/UI Design Consumer Insights Customer Experience & Product Support Here are some of the EXCITING things you’ll get to do: Contribute to real product launches across Shark, Ninja, and Beauty, from early research and concepting through to shelf Translate consumer insights into product and design decisions that shape what actually gets built Bring ideas to life through sketches, renderings, prototypes, wireframes, and design specifications Conduct hands-on product testing and competitive research, and document findings that influence design direction Present your work and the thinking behind it to cross-functional partners and design leads — and incorporate their feedback Collaborate across Product Development, Industrial Design, Engineering, Marketing, Consumer Insights, and Product Management Gain exposure to the full product development cycle, solving simultaneously for performance, cost, and delight Own a meaningful project end to end and present your contributions experience — human factors, touchpoints, KPIs, and Consumer Satisfaction Indicators — and championing them to engineers, industrial designers, and commercial marketers Acting as a product “expert” for cross-functional questions, and assisting with new product setups, product information management, and competitive landscape development Supporting qualitative and quantitative research, designing and refining research tools such as surveys and discussion guides, and translating unmet and latent needs into clear recommendations for new products and features Building customer personas and journey maps, identifying whitespace opportunities and consumer pain points, and monitoring competitors and market trends to inform positioning Supporting the post-purchase consumer journey — replacement Industrial, CMF & Digital Experience Design Translating consumer insights into bold, user-centered design solutions through sketches, illustrations, and high-fidelity renderings Creating product designs in SolidWorks or Rhino, producing renderings in KeyShot, and collaborating with Engineering to deliver clean, production-ready CAD files Specifying the full look and feel of a product — surface finish, color, material, texture, and branding — and creating, tracking, and maintaining color specifications (ID SPECS) Developing color palette proposals targeted for different retailers, organizing supplier CMF samples into a material library, and working to standards such as Pantone, NCS, SPI, YickSang, and Mold-Tech Supporting UI design, icon design, and rating/warning label creation, and interacting daily with the APAC manufacturing team, suppliers, and the Compliance team Creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, and visual design specs in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch for mobile app and embedded UI experiences Participating in usability testing, maintaining and evolving design systems for cross-platform consistency, and designing for accessibility, responsiveness, and internationalization Building visual and functional prototypes, and exploring emerging trends, new materials, and future-forward aesthetics ATTRIBUTES & SKILLS: Current student in a related bachelor's or master’s or PhD program or has graduated from such a program within the past year — Industrial Design, Product Design, UX/UI or Interaction Design, Mechanical Engineering, Marketing, Market Research, Psychology or Sociology, Culinary Arts or Food Science, Business, Communications, or similar Must be able to work a full-time, 40-hour-per-week onsite-hybrid schedule; specific location and number of onsite days vary by team and term A consumer-first perspective and real curiosity about how people actually use products in their homes Strong visual and verbal storytelling — you can present an idea, explain the thinking behind it, and take feedback well Meticulous attention to detail, and the discipline to hold onto it under tight deadlines Strong organizational and project management instincts; comfortable juggling multiple projects and shifting priorities Hands-on and resourceful — willing to build the rough version, test it, and iterate Able to synthesize complex or messy input into clear, actionable recommendations Collaborative and positive in brainstorms, critiques, and reviews Proficient in Microsoft 365, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook Prior internship, co-op, studio, kitchen, research, or personal project experience is a strong asset Any of the following are a plus — we don’t expect all of them: CAD and 3D: SolidWorks, Creo, or Rhino; rendering in KeyShot Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop Design and prototyping tools: Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch Prototyping and shop competency: 3D printing, machine shop equipment, building in plastic and metal Color and materials standards: Pantone, NCS, SPI, YickSang, Mold-Tech; interest in color communication toward international standards Basic understanding of electronics commonly used in small appliances (motors, sensors, PCBAs) Accessibility best practices and responsive design principles; interest in connected consumer products, smart home technology, or IoT ecosystems Coursework in market research, consumer insights, psychology, sociology, or related social sciences Prior experience in food service, recipe testing, or culinary R&D Project tracking and file management tools such as Asana, Monday, Airtable, Box, or SharePoint Work samples: If you’re interested in a design role — Industrial Design, CMF, or UX/UI — please include a portfolio that demonstrates your design process, not just your finished work. You can link it in your resume or attach it in the cover letter field. A portfolio is not required for consideration for Product Development, Ninja Test Kitchen, Consumer Insights, or Customer Experience & Product Support. This evergreen job post is for upcoming Product Development, Design & Consumer Insights Co-ops at SharkNinja. We’re continuously seeking exceptional candidates who aspire to make a positive impact on people’s lives. Your application will be thoroughly reviewed for potential future opportunities within our team. We encourage you to explore all relevant current openings and apply accordingly. Salary and Other Compensation: The hourly salary range for this position is displayed below. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, health savings account (HSA) with company contribution, sick time, company holidays, employee product discount, product testing opportunities, referral bonuses, and more. Hourly Pay Range $26 — $35 USD Our Culture At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home. What We Offer We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. To gether, we won’t just launch products— we’ll disrupt entire markets. At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA. Learn more about us:

roles.title: Product User Research, Intern
roles.description: ABOUT SARVAM AI Sarvam AI is building India's sovereign AI stack, spanning foundational models, infrastructure and applications. Our mission is to make powerful AI accessible and useful for India, building technology that works across languages, industries and real-world use cases. As we continue to build and scale our products, understanding how people interact with them becomes increasingly important. We're looking for a curious and research-oriented intern to help us understand our users better and shape the experiences we build. THE ROLE As a Product User Research Intern, you'll work closely with our product, design and engineering teams to understand user behaviour, identify friction points and uncover opportunities to improve our products. You'll interact directly with developers, product managers and founders, study how they use Sarvam's products, and translate your findings into actionable insights that influence product and design decisions. This is an opportunity to work on a new user research function at Sarvam, helping establish research practices and processes from the ground up. You'll also get ownership of a primary product area and the opportunity to see your research translate into real product improvements. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON - Understand our users: Conduct user interviews, surveys and usability studies with developers, PMs and founders to understand their needs, behaviours and challenges. - Improve product experiences: Research user journeys across Sarvam's developer console, playground, API documentation and applications. Identify friction points across onboarding, API key creation, first API calls, billing and other key workflows. - Study developer journeys: Analyse the developer funnel, from sign-up to making the first API call and eventually becoming a paying user. Understand where users drop off and, more importantly, why. - Test and evaluate designs: Conduct usability testing on existing interfaces and new prototypes, run preference and A/B tests, and benchmark experiences against other developer products. - Turn research into insights: Analyse qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns and present clear recommendations to product, design, growth and support teams. - Build the research practice: Help establish research playbooks, interview templates, participant recruitment processes and a research repository that can scale with the team. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Strong curiosity about user behaviour and a genuine interest in understanding why people use products the way they do. - Comfortable speaking with users, conducting interviews and asking thoughtful, unbiased questions. - Technical fluency — you should be comfortable reading API documentation, making basic API calls using tools like Postman, curl or Python, and understanding what might have gone wrong when an API fails. - Comfortable working with data, analysing spreadsheets and interpreting product funnels or dashboards. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate research findings into clear insights and recommendations. - Familiarity with AI tools and developer products, and an interest in exploring how they can improve research workflows. GOOD TO HAVE - Experience with SQL or product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or Metabase. - Familiarity with user research methodologies, usability testing and survey design. - Experience reviewing Figma prototypes or conducting user interviews. - Previous research projects, internships or personal projects involving products you've built or shipped. - Fluency in one or more Indian languages. WHO CAN APPLY? - Final-year students or graduates who have completed their studies within the last 12 months. - Candidates from engineering, psychology, economics, design or social science backgrounds. - Individuals who can commit to a full-time, 6-month, in-office internship in Bengaluru. WHAT YOU'LL GET - The opportunity to help build Sarvam's user research function from the ground up. - Direct exposure to product, design and engineering teams working on India's sovereign AI ecosystem. - Hands-on experience researching developer products and real-world AI applications. - Ownership of meaningful research projects with findings that directly influence product decisions. - An opportunity to work closely with experienced product leaders and learn how research translates into better products. - Potential for a pre-placement offer (PPO) based on performance.

roles.title: Program Management Intern
roles.description: At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing-in-ground-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo - connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before. Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production - and building the team to make it happen. ROLE OVERVIEW REGENT's Paladin test program is where engineering development, vehicle maintenance, and on-water testing all converge, and this internship sits right at the center of it. You'll build and maintain the schedule that the entire program runs on, working directly with the vehicle and the test team rather than tracking progress from behind a desk. This is a DPM-style role in the truest sense: the milestone tracker isn't a document you update once a week, it's something you actively manage so that engineers, maintenance crews, and test leads are always working from the same plan. You'll join the Engineering & Technology Program Management team, a group that treats planning and tracking as real engineering work, not administrative overhead. Along the way, you'll be taught to see cost and schedule as engineering variables in their own right, a lens that's genuinely valuable whether you're headed toward program leadership or engineering management down the road. If you're someone who gets energized by being in the middle of the action, who sees a plan as something to steer rather than observe, and who wants hands-on exposure to how a real flight test program comes together, we'd love to have you on the team. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the Master Schedule: You'll build and keep current the milestone tracker that ties together engineering, maintenance, and on-water testing for Paladin. This is a living document you actively manage, not something you dust off weekly. - Get Hands-On with Paladin: You'll spend real time with the vehicle and the test team, not just behind a laptop. Being in the mix is how you'll understand what's actually happening on the ground, not just what's on paper. - Support Vehicle Maintenance: You'll pitch in on maintenance work between test runs, giving you direct insight into what keeps Paladin flight-ready. That proximity to the vehicle is what makes your tracking actually useful. - Know What Complete Really Means: You'll learn to distinguish between a part being ordered, installed, and tested, so your schedule reflects reality rather than optimism. That distinction is what keeps the whole program honest. - Keep the Team Aligned: You'll make sure engineering, maintenance, and test ops are working from the same set of assumptions about what's next. When the plan stays current, the whole program moves faster together. - Launch Your Own Initiatives: You'll take on program initiatives you can plan, manage, and see through to completion. By the end of your term, you'll be able to point to specific projects you drove start to finish. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - Scheduling Tool Fluency: You're comfortable in Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, or a similar tool. The specific platform matters less than being able to hit the ground organizing the program instead of learning software. - Self-Directed Ownership: You can build and maintain a tracker across multiple workstreams without someone feeding you updates. You treat the plan as something to manage proactively, not react to. - Mechanical Curiosity: Hands-on experience with engines, hulls, or mechanical systems, whether through marine, automotive, or other tinkering, gives you a head start here. A meaningful part of this role involves real vehicle maintenance support. - Technical Grounding: You understand what an engineering or test milestone actually means when it's marked complete. That understanding is what keeps a schedule accurate instead of just looking fine on paper. - Comfort Across Contexts: You're just as comfortable updating a tracker as you are standing next to the vehicle with the test team. You don't need the two worlds kept separate. - Natural Organizational Instinct: You bring structure to dynamic, fast-moving work without slowing it down. You see a plan as something worth actively shaping. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Collaborative Team Player: You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You communicate effectively and collaborate with engineers, stakeholders, and other cross-functional teams to align on goals and move projects forward. You bring people together, ensuring that everyone is on the same page and moving towards a shared vision. - Creative Problem Solver: You thrive on tackling complex challenges and finding innovative solutions. Whether you're resolving installation challenges, debugging elusive electrical issues, or adapting on the fly during integration and test, you bring a practical, inventive mindset to every problem. You don't just patch issues - you improve processes, anticipate downstream impacts, and help turn one-off fixes into scalable solutions that raise the bar for future builds. - Adaptable & Agile: In a fast-paced, ever-evolving startup environment, you quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements. You approach challenges with a calm, resilient mindset, and know how to pivot and adjust your approach as needed, ensuring that progress continues without missing a beat. - Innovative Mindset: You're driven by curiosity and a passion for technology. You're passionate about driving continuous improvement, embracing new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and team performance. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive compensation - Housing Stipend available for those temporarily moving to join our team - Daily, free catered lunches - Learning & professional development opportunities - Meaningful projects that make an impact - Mentorship & guidance from experienced team members If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact. Equal Opportunity Employer REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

roles.description: WHO IS LITMUS Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI. AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap. We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production. Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing. WHY JOIN LITMUS BUILD THE INFRASTRUCTURE THAT MAKES INDUSTRIAL AI POSSIBLE AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments. WORK ON PROBLEMS WHERE SOFTWARE MEETS THE REAL WORLD Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable. HAVE REAL IMPACT, FAST You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale. JOIN A HIGH-PERFORMANCE TEAM We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers. OUR CULTURE At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other. We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Recruiting and People Ops Intern in Toronto to support our growing global Talent team and People Operations in Toronto. You’ll keep our hiring process running smoothly, coordinate interviews across time zones, and help create a great experience for every candidate. You’ll also learn how to run first-round screens for some roles. A part of this role is learning how to use AI in recruiting and People Ops. You’ll use AI tools to make our processes faster and more consistent, help build automations, and support recruiting and People metrics. If you’re interested in People Operations, there’s also the option to split your time and work on projects with our People Ops team, such as onboarding, employee experience, and HR operations. This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced startup. You’ll get real ownership, learn how a Talent and People team is built, and see the full employee lifecycle from candidate to new hire. WHAT YOU’LL DO RECRUITING COORDINATION - Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels across time zones - Conduct first-round screens with candidates to assess fit and share notes with the Talent team - Be a main point of contact for candidates, keeping them informed and supported throughout the process - Keep candidate data in Ashby clean and up to date - Help prepare interview materials and make sure interviewers have what they need - Help coordinate pre-hire steps and handoffs to People Operations - Support employer brand projects, such as job postings, career page content, and events AI AND METRICS - Learn to use AI tools for recruiting and People Ops tasks, such as drafting candidate communications, summarizing interview notes, and preparing documents - Help find ways to use AI and automation to improve our recruiting and People Ops processes - Build and maintain recruiting and People metrics, such as time-to-fill, pipeline health, and source effectiveness - Help prepare reports and dashboards for the Talent and People Ops teams - Share what you learn with the team and help document AI workflows and best practices PEOPLE OPERATIONS (OPTIONAL) - Support new hire onboarding, including preparing materials and coordinating first-week schedules - Help maintain employee records and HR documentation - Help with employee experience projects and company events - Support other People Ops projects as they come up WHAT YOU’LL BRING MUST HAVE - Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a university or college program (co-op applicants must be enrolled in an eligible co-op program) - Strong interest in recruiting, People Operations, or HR - Strong interest in AI and how it can be used to improve the way teams work - Strong written and verbal communication skills, and comfortable speaking with candidates - Very organized and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple schedules and tasks at once - Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets - Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where not everything is defined yet - Curious and eager to learn, with a willingness to take ownership - Able to work in our Toronto office on a hybrid schedule NICE TO HAVE - Previous internship or work experience in recruiting, HR, or a coordination or administrative role - Hands-on experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT - Experience with automation or no-code tools, or building simple reports and dashboards - Familiarity with Ashby - Interest in tech, startups, or AI Location: Toronto, Canada (hybrid) Start Date: Flexible. We’re open to full-time or part-time starting now, or a co-op term starting January 2027. Litmus Automation is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe diverse perspectives lead to innovation.

roles.title: Spring 2027 Legal Intern, Affiliate Support and Nationwide Initiatives- Policy
roles.description: The ACLU of Puerto Rico seeks a bilingual Legal & Policy Intern for their Affiliate Support and Nationwide Initiatives Department (ASNI) in our San Juan, Puerto Rico office. This internship is hybrid and can be full-time or part-time. Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated legal students. Applicant must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship. The Team: The A SNI department builds state capacity and strengthens the connections between the ACLU and its network of 54 state affiliates and their 1,500 staff members across the country. The affiliates’ work constitutes an unparalleled bulwark defending and advancing our civil liberties and civil rights. ASNI staff lead efforts to build program, build organizations, and drive resources to key battles across the country, positioning the nationwide organization for future challenges. The ACLU of Puerto Rico is a chapter of the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) a nationwide, nonprofit, nonpartisan organization, dedicated to protecting the fundamental liberties and basic civil rights guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution and our civil rights laws. This includes efforts, among others, related to: C riminal J ustice, First Amendment, LGBTQ+ R ights, V oting R ights, P rivacy R ights, R eproductive F reedom and W omen’s R ights. This internship can be full-time or part-time and is hybrid from our San Juan, Puerto Rico office. Time Commitment: Full-time (35hrs/week) or Part-time (10, 15 or 20hrs/week) Internship Duration: Full-time internships span 10 consecutive weeks and Part-time internships span 12 consecutive weeks. This internship has a start date of: Jan. 11th or Jan. 25th, 2027 Stipend: A stipend is available for students who are lawfully authorized to work. Arrangements can be made with educational institutions for work/study or course credit. Below are the stipend rates: $24/hr for graduate and law students or equivalent experience This internship must be tied to the intern’s formal education program by integrated coursework or the receipt of academic credit. Why the ACLU: For over 100 years, the ACLU has worked to defend and preserve the individual rights and liberties guaranteed by the Constitution and laws of the United States. Whether it’s ending mass incarceration, achieving full equality for the LGBTQ+ community, establishing new privacy protections for our digital age, or preserving the right to vote or the right to have an abortion, the ACLU takes up the toughest civil liberties cases and issues to defend all people. Our Commitment to Accessibility, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Accessibility, equity, diversity, and inclusion are core values of the ACLU and central to our work to advance liberty, equality, and justice for all. For us diversity, equity and inclusion are not just check-the-box activities, but a chance for us to make long-term meaningful change. We are a community committed to learning and growth, humility and grace, transparency and accountability. We believe in a collective responsibility to create a culture of belonging for all people within our organization – one that respects and embraces difference; treats everyone equitably; and empowers our colleagues to do the best work possible. We are as committed to anti-oppression and anti-racism internally as we are externally. Because whether we’re in the courts or in the office, we believe ‘We the People’ means all of us. With this commitment in mind, we strongly encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status and record of arrest or conviction, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. roles.description: Talent Acquisition Intern This internship offers hands-on experience in Talent Acquisition while supporting projects that contribute directly to business objectives. Working alongside experienced professionals, you will gain exposure to recruiting processes, candidate engagement, and the systems and practices that help attract and hire talent. Through mentorship, regular feedback, and cross-departmental collaboration, you will strengthen your communication, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills while building a foundation for a career in Talent Acquisition or Human Resources. Responsibilities Support the Talent Acquisition team with recruiting activities, including candidate sourcing, interview coordination, and candidate communications. Assist with reviewing job postings for clarity, consistency, and accuracy. Conduct research on talent markets, recruiting practices, and other topics that support hiring priorities. Participate in career fairs to identify candidates for annual internship program. Help maintain accurate candidate information and recruiting records in the applicant tracking system. Assist with internship program coordination and recruitment activities during peak hiring periods. Contribute to recruiting reports, presentations, and process improvement projects. Participate in regular check-ins with team members and mentors to review progress, receive feedback, and build professional skills. Present project findings, progress, and recommendations to the team. Explore opportunities to shadow colleagues across departments to broaden business knowledge and build professional connections. Competencies Being Resilient: Rebounding from setbacks and adapting when facing challenges. Drives Results: Following through on assignments and achieving results. Ensures Accountability: Taking ownership of responsibilities and meeting commitments. Qualifications Must be enrolled full-time and actively pursuing a degree at an accredited college or university. Students in their junior year of a bachelor’s degree program in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field are preferred. Demonstrated interest in Talent Acquisition and Human Resources. Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and organizational abilities. Interest in research and problem-solving, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively. Ability to manage multiple assignments and handle confidential information with discretion. roles.description: Talent Management Intern Function: Talent Management / Human Resources Location: San Jose, California, United States Employment type: Internship About the role As a Talent Management Intern at Astera Labs, you will contribute to meaningful work that strengthens how we develop talent, support employee growth, and scale our talent-management programs. You will learn the current state of our talent-management processes, take ownership of a defined project or workstream, and partner with HR leaders, HR business partners, and the Talent Management team to deliver measurable outcomes. This internship is designed for a student who is curious, organized, comfortable learning quickly, and excited to turn ideas into well-executed programs, processes, and deliverables. Key responsibilities Own a meaningful project: Define milestones, manage priorities, and deliver a scoped talent-management project or workstream within the internship timeline. Support talent programs: Contribute to program and workshop design, preparation, coordination, execution, and follow-up. Apply talent-management practices: Build foundational knowledge of competency frameworks, skill matrices, talent assessments, and related process flows. Improve how work gets done: Identify opportunities to streamline existing processes, support global scale, or design a new program or workflow. Coordinate with stakeholders: Partner with HR leaders, HR business partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to gather input, clarify requirements, and move work forward. Track and communicate progress: Maintain clear milestones, surface blockers early, share regular updates, and connect project progress to aligned key performance indicators. Create clear deliverables: Develop practical documentation, analyses, program materials, recommendations, or other assets that the team can use and build on. Incorporate feedback and share impact: Iterate on your work, implement feedback, and communicate what you delivered, what you learned, and why it mattered. Basic qualifications Currently enrolled in a college or graduate program. Interest in talent management, employee development, organizational development, human resources, program design, or a related field. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to organize work, manage deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Demonstrated problem-solving skills and willingness to ask thoughtful questions. Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders and work with a high degree of ownership. Preferred qualifications Coursework, project, or internship experience related to talent management, human resources, organizational development, business, psychology, or a related area. Exposure to competency frameworks, skill matrices, talent assessments, program coordination, or workshop design. Experience organizing information, analyzing inputs, documenting processes, or developing program materials. Comfort working across teams and adapting to evolving priorities. Interest in building a career in talent management or broader people programs. What success looks like You build context quickly and understand how Talent Management supports Astera Labs. You deliver high-quality project outcomes on time and communicate progress clearly. You demonstrate ownership, sound judgment, problem solving, and cross-team agility. You use feedback to improve your work and recommend practical process improvements. You can clearly explain the problem you addressed, what you delivered, and the impact of your work. Internship experience and compensation This is a paid, hourly U.S. internship. The applicable hourly rate is determined as part of the offer process and specified in the offer letter, depending on education level ranges form $35/hour to $55/hour. U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship. Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation. roles.title: Clinical Research Assistant
roles.description: Join Us in Shaping the Future of Clinical Research Adams Clinical is a leading clinical trial site network committed to accelerating the development of life-changing medicines. Our mission is simple: deliver uncompromising data quality, safety, and diverse enrollment to advance healthcare. Our vision is to set the gold standard for clinical trial excellence. We believe our people make the difference. Guided by our core values—Scientific Rigor, Operational Excellence, Commitment to Sponsors and Participants, and Authentic Collaboration—we create an environment where meaningful work drives meaningful change. At Adams Clinical, you’ll find: A culture of respect, transparency, and continuous improvement Opportunities for professional growth and learning A team dedicated to improving lives through innovation and integrity If you’re passionate about making an impact in clinical research and want to be part of a collaborative, mission-driven organization, we’d love to have you on our team. Overview Adams Clinical is a rapidly growing research site network specializing focused on late phase industry-sponsored trials of novel treatments for a variety of psychiatric and neurological conditions, supporting both inpatient and outpatient studies. We are seeking entry-level applicants for the Clinical Research Assistant role at our Bronx location. This role is ideal for entry-level candidates interested in learning clinical research operations, contributing to study execution, and developing foundational skills in patient interaction, data management, and regulatory compliance. The Clinical Research Assistant (RA) provides foundational support in the conduct of clinical trials at the site level. Working under the direct supervision of a CRC II, CRC III, or Site Manager, the RA assists with operational, administrative, and participant-facing tasks to ensure studies run smoothly and in accordance with ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and protocol guidelines. This role is an ideal entry point for individuals seeking to gain hands-on experience in clinical research. Key Responsibilities Support study start-up activities, including supply inventory, document preparation, and site initiation readiness. Assist with participant screening workflows as delegated, including scheduling screening visits and collecting basic information such as demographics, medical history, and other study-relevant details to support eligibility assessment. Schedule and prepare for participant visits, including source prep, lab kits, and CRFs. Serve as a participant liaison—confirm appointments, coordinate transportation, and maintain ongoing communication. Escort and assist participants during on-site visits; perform vital signs, ECGs, and specimen collection/processing as trained. Complete accurate, ALCOA+-compliant source documentation for delegated procedures. Perform data entry into EDC systems and assist with query resolution. Maintain study binders, charts, and logs; support supply management. Ensure accurate capture and upload of paper source documents into eSource systems in accordance with site processes and regulatory requirements, supporting long-term retention and audit readiness. Obtain, track, and manage medical releases, as well as medical and pharmacy records from external providers as needed, in accordance with site SOPs and protocol requirements. Support CRCs during monitoring visits and assist with preparing documentation and materials to ensure audit and inspection readiness. Assist with investigational product (IP) accountability tasks as needed and where applicable, gaining exposure to IP handling, tracking, and documentation under the direct supervision of CRC staff, while ensuring adherence to protocol and site SOPs. Develop proficiency in site SOPs, institutional policies, and GCP requirements to build foundational knowledge in compliant research practices. Assist in collecting and entering study data into trackers, logs, and EDC systems, focusing on accurate and timely data collection. Support CRCs in maintaining accurate records and updating study metrics. Qualifications Minimum requirement of a high school diploma or GED equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred. No prior clinical research experience is necessary; training will be provided. Basic understanding of clinical research principles is a plus. Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Willingness to perform phlebotomy and clinical procedures as trained. Pay : $24.00 - $29.00 per hour Benefits : 401(k) matching Medical, Dental, & Vision insurance Employee assistance program Flexible spending account Health insurance Health savings account Life insurance Paid time off Parental leave Professional development assistance Adams Clinical is committed to being an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We focus on hiring and nurturing top talent. All employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, transfer, training, discipline, and termination, are made based on the candidate's or employee's qualifications relevant to the position. These decisions are made without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status. In compliance with federal law, all individuals hired must, as a condition of employment, provide documentation verifying their identity and authorization to work in the United States and complete Form I-9 within the required timeframe. Adams Clinical participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility.

This role is ideal for entry-level candidates interested in learning clinical research operations, contributing to study execution, and developing foundational skills in patient interaction, data management, and regulatory compliance. The Clinical Research Assistant (RA) provides foundational support in the conduct of clinical trials at the site level. Working under the direct supervision of a CRC II, CRC III, or Site Manager, the RA assists with operational, administrative, and participant-facing tasks to ensure studies run smoothly and in accordance with ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and protocol guidelines. This role is an ideal entry point for individuals seeking to gain hands-on experience in clinical research. Key Responsibilities: Support study start-up activities, including supply inventory, document preparation, and site initiation readiness. Assist with participant screening workflows as delegated, including scheduling screening visits and collecting basic information such as demographics, medical history, and other study-relevant details to support eligibility assessment. Schedule and prepare for participant visits, including source prep, lab kits, and CRFs. Complete accurate, ALCOA+-compliant source documentation for delegated procedures. Perform data entry into EDC systems and assist with query resolution. Maintain study binders, charts, and logs; support supply management. Ensure accurate capture and upload of paper source documents into eSource systems in accordance with site processes and regulatory requirements, supporting long-term retention and audit readiness. No prior clinical research experience is necessary; training will be provided. Basic understanding of clinical research principles is a plus. Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Willingness to perform phlebotomy and clinical procedures as trained. roles.description: Recruiting Coordinator Location: San Jose, CA Job Type: Full-Time (40 Hours Per Week) Pay Range: $24 - $28 About Think Academy: Think Academy US ( www.TheThinkAcademy.com ), a 100% owned subsidiary of TAL Education Group(NYSE: TAL), is recently established education technology (Ed-Tech) company to provide K-12 extra-curricular learning services through science and technology. At Think Academy, we provide full cycle service to foster local children’s ability to think critically, to strengthen their logic skills, and to help them fulfill their goals through innovative teaching techniques. We believe Love and Technology can make education better. Each week, more than 6 million students are enrolled in TAL's online and offline education platform. About the Job: Think Academy is a forward-thinking educational institution committed to empowering students through innovative learning experiences. As we continue to grow, we're seeking a dedicated and motivated Recruiting Intern to join our dynamic HR Team. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the end-to-end recruitment process within the education sector. Job Responsibilities : Source and screen potential candidates through various channels ensuring a diverse and talented pool of applicants for multiple job openings Assist in the coordination of interview processes, including scheduling, preparing interview materials, and collecting feedback Collaborate with the HR team to identify staffing needs and develop effective recruitment strategies Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in our ATS and company logs Assist in the development of job descriptions and postings over platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, Handshake, etc. Support HR initiatives and projects as needed by the team Job Qualifications: Currently pursuing a degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; new graduates are also welcome to apply Excellent written and verbal communication skills Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail; ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment Proficiency in programs such as Microsoft Office Suite, Zoom, Calendly, etc. Familiarity with applicant tracking systems such as Greenhouse is preferred, but not required Eagerness to learn and contribute to the recruitment process Strong sense of discretion and confidentiality Milk tea connoisseur! Think Academy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

roles.title: Recruiting Coordinator
roles.description: Reports to : Director of Recruiting Job Summary : The Recruiting Coordinator will support campus recruiting initiatives that drive Saxbys' talent acquisition efforts on new & existing college campuses. This entry-level role provides vital administrative and logistical support to the Campus Recruiting team while developing fundamental recruiting skills through hands-on training with Campus Recruiters. What You Will Own Recruiting & Interviewing: Support the full lifecycle recruiting of our cafe team members for our ELP campus cafes. Administrative Support: Coordinate the full recruiting lifecycle including candidate communications, interview scheduling, and follow-up. Maintain job postings across various platforms and process candidate applications in the Applicant Tracking System. Track candidate statuses and prepare regular recruiting metrics reports. Recruitment Marketing: Identify and evaluate on-campus recruitment opportunities, with particular focus on emerging café markets. Research and recommend participation in school events and initiatives that effectively promote employment opportunities to target audiences. Event Coordination: Assist with planning and executing campus recruiting events, career fairs, and information sessions. Prepare recruiting materials, coordinate logistics, and help maintain a positive brand presence at all recruiting events. Candidate Experience: Ensure all candidates have a positive experience throughout the recruiting process. Serve as an initial point of contact for candidates, providing timely responses and clear communication about next steps in the hiring process. Data Management: Maintain accurate and timely candidate data across all systems and trackers. Provide up-to-date information on candidate statuses and generate reports on recruiting metrics as required by the team and leadership. Who You Will Support Campus Recruiters: Support efforts to build key university relationships and attract top talent to Saxbys. Assist with screening candidates, scheduling interviews, and coordinating onboarding for new hires. Accompany Campus Recruiters to recruiting events as part of training and development. Operations and EL&I Teams: Collaborate with Operations and EL&I teams to understand and support hiring needs across multiple regions. Assist with coordinating onboarding logistics for new hires. What Success Looks Like 100% of administrative tasks completed accurately and on time Candidates receive responses within 48 hours of application or inquiry All recruiting events properly staffed and supplied with necessary materials Recruiting data accurately maintained with weekly reporting Positive feedback from candidates on their recruiting experience Where You Excel Attention to Detail Organization and Time Management Interpersonal Communication Problem Solving and Adaptability Being a brand ambassador Curiosity What You Have Done 0-1 years of experience in an administrative, customer service, or campus ambassador role Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities Proven success in team environments with excellent communication skills Experience using Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel Developed professional written and verbal communication abilities What is Required Support, exhibit, and promote Saxbys Mission and Core Values in all daily activities. Travel Requirement % (if 0%, delete) Valid driver's license if required to drive Physical requirements: Able to stand, walk, and smile for extended periods of time Able to stoop and kneel Push, pull, lift or carry up to 35 lbs Ascend or descend ladders, stairs, ramps
